title: Vectors, Space & Uncertainty — Class XII, Chapters 10–13
subject: mathematics
source: Personal study notes from my own Class XII Mathematics revision project (Days 27–33, including the capstone), where each theorem was verified in NumPy/SymPy and mapped onto aerospace, electronics and computing.
summary: Direction as a number and the two products that answer different questions; the skew case that only exists in three dimensions and the collision screening built on it; the corner-point theorem and the solver that confidently answers the opposite question; base rates that survive strong evidence; and the capstone where four engines become one pipeline.
